<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>केळसत्व — Pure Banana Flour</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,400;9..144,500;9..144,600&family=Work+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);

    --cream: #FBF6EC;
    --leaf: #2F4A3C;
    --leaf-deep: #1E332A;
    --mustard: #D9A441;
    --earth: #6B4A32;
    --clay: #A85B2A;
    --ink: #2A2420;

    --serif: "Fraunces", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    --sans: "Work Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  }
  html { scroll-padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: inherit; }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    background: var(--cream);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: var(--sans);
    line-height: 1.55;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
  }

  img, svg { max-width: 100%; }
  .wrap { max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 28px; }

  a { color: inherit; }
  a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--clay); outline-offset: 3px; }

  /* ---------- Nav ---------- */
  header.site {
    position: sticky; top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); z-index: 10;
    background: var(--cream);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(42,36,32,0.1);
  }
  .nav {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 18px 28px;
  }
  .brand { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.3rem; color: var(--leaf-deep); text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: 0.2px; }
  .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 28px; font-size: 0.95rem; }
  .nav-links a { text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink); }
  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--clay); }
  .nav-cta {
    background: var(--leaf); color: var(--cream); padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 3px;
    text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .nav-cta:hover { background: var(--leaf-deep); }
  @media (max-width: 640px) { .nav-links { display: none; } }

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
  .hero { padding: 72px 0 56px; }
  .hero .wrap { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr; gap: 48px; align-items: center; }
  @media (max-width: 800px) { .hero .wrap { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .hero h1 {
    font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 5vw, 3.3rem);
    line-height: 1.08; margin: 0 0 20px; color: var(--leaf-deep);
  }
  .hero p.lede { font-size: 1.1rem; max-width: 46ch; color: var(--earth); margin: 0 0 30px; }
  .hero-ctas { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .btn-primary {
    background: var(--clay); color: var(--cream); padding: 14px 26px; border-radius: 3px;
    text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: #8C4A20; }
  .btn-secondary {
    border: 1.5px solid var(--leaf); color: var(--leaf-deep); padding: 13px 24px; border-radius: 3px;
    text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem;
  }
  .btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(47,74,60,0.08); }

  .hero-art { display: flex; justify-content: center; }
  .hero-art svg { width: 100%; height: auto; max-width: 380px; }
  .hero-art img { width: 100%; height: auto; max-width: 360px; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(30,51,42,0.18); }

  /* ---------- Strip ---------- */
  .strip {
    background: var(--leaf); color: var(--cream);
    padding: 16px 0;
  }
  .strip .wrap { display: flex; gap: 32px; justify-content: space-around; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 0.92rem; }
  .strip span { white-space: nowrap; }

  /* ---------- Sections ---------- */
  section { padding: 76px 0; }
  .section-head { max-width: 60ch; margin: 0 0 40px; }
  h2 {
    font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3.4vw, 2.2rem);
    color: var(--leaf-deep); margin: 0 0 14px;
  }
  .section-head p { color: var(--earth); margin: 0; font-size: 1.02rem; }

  /* Benefits */
  .benefits { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 32px; }
  @media (max-width: 760px) { .benefits { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .benefit { border-top: 2px solid var(--mustard); padding-top: 18px; }
  .benefit h3 { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 500; margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--leaf-deep); }
  .benefit p { margin: 0; color: var(--earth); font-size: 0.97rem; }

  /* Process */
  .process { background: var(--leaf-deep); color: var(--cream); }
  .process .section-head p { color: rgba(251,246,236,0.75); }
  .process .section-head h2 { color: var(--cream); }
  .steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
  @media (max-width: 800px) { .steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
  @media (max-width: 480px) { .steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .step { border-left: 2px solid var(--mustard); padding-left: 16px; }
  .step .num { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 1.6rem; color: var(--mustard); display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .step h3 { font-size: 1.02rem; font-weight: 500; margin: 0 0 6px; }
  .step p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.92rem; color: rgba(251,246,236,0.72); }

  /* Uses */
  .uses-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 20px; }
  @media (max-width: 700px) { .uses-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .use-card {
    background: #FFFDF8; border: 1px solid rgba(42,36,32,0.1); border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 22px 24px;
  }
  .use-card h3 { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.08rem; margin: 0 0 6px; color: var(--leaf-deep); }
  .use-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--earth); font-size: 0.95rem; }

  /* Product / pricing */
  .product-wrap {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.8fr 1.2fr; gap: 44px; align-items: center;
    background: #FFFDF8; border: 1px solid rgba(42,36,32,0.1); border-radius: 6px; padding: 40px;
  }
  @media (max-width: 760px) { .product-wrap { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 28px; } }
  .pack-art { display: flex; justify-content: center; }
  .pack-art svg { width: 100%; max-width: 220px; height: auto; }
  .pack-art img { width: 100%; max-width: 260px; height: auto; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 14px 32px rgba(30,51,42,0.16); }
  .price-table { display: flex; gap: 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 6px 0 22px; }
  .price-item { background: var(--cream); border: 1px solid rgba(42,36,32,0.12); border-radius: 6px; padding: 14px 20px; }
  .price-item .amt { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--clay); font-weight: 600; display: block; }
  .price-item .unit { font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--earth); }
  .price-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; margin: 6px 0 22px; }
  .price { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 2.1rem; color: var(--clay); font-weight: 600; }
  .price-unit { color: var(--earth); font-size: 0.95rem; }
  .specs { list-style: none; margin: 0 0 26px; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--earth); }
  .specs li { padding-left: 18px; position: relative; }
  .specs li::before { content: "—"; position: absolute; left: 0; color: var(--mustard); }

  /* Order / footer */
  .order { background: var(--mustard); }
  .order .wrap { text-align: center; max-width: 560px; }
  .order h2 { color: var(--leaf-deep); }
  .order p { color: var(--leaf-deep); opacity: 0.85; margin: 0 0 28px; }
  .order .btn-primary { background: var(--leaf-deep); }
  .order .btn-primary:hover { background: #12201A; }

  footer.site { background: var(--leaf-deep); color: rgba(251,246,236,0.7); padding: 36px 0; font-size: 0.9rem; }
  footer.site .wrap { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; }
  footer.site a { color: var(--cream); text-decoration: none; }
</style>
</head>

  <section id="why">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="section-head">
        <h2>Why cooks are switching to it</h2>
        <p>Unripe bananas are mostly resistant starch — that's what gives this flour its texture and its edge over regular wheat flour.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="benefits">
        <div class="benefit">
          <h3>Gentle on digestion</h3>
          <p>The resistant starch behaves more like fibre than sugar, so it digests slowly and sits easier than refined wheat flour.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="benefit">
          <h3>Naturally gluten-free</h3>
          <p>No wheat, no gluten, no cross-contamination in the mill — safe for coeliac and gluten-sensitive kitchens.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="benefit">
          <h3>Neutral, mild flavour</h3>
          <p>Unlike ripe banana, the green fruit has almost no sweetness — it takes on curry, roti, or cake batter without fighting it.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="process" class="process">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="section-head">
        <h2>From bunch to bag</h2>
        <p>Four steps, no shortcuts.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="steps">
        <div class="step"><span class="num">01</span><h3>Harvest green</h3><p>Bananas are picked while still starchy and unripe, before the sugars develop.</p></div>
        <div class="step"><span class="num">02</span><h3>Peel &amp; slice</h3><p>Peeled by hand and sliced thin within hours of harvest to stop browning.</p></div>
        <div class="step"><span class="num">03</span><h3>Sun-dry</h3><p>Dried slowly at low heat to lock in the resistant starch and nutrients.</p></div>
        <div class="step"><span class="num">04</span><h3>Stone-grind</h3><p>Ground fine on stone, then sieved and packed — nothing added.</p></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

      </div>

        <div class="use-card"><h3>थालीपीठ</h3><p>A savoury multigrain-style pancake — banana flour adds body and a mild, earthy base.</p></div>
        <div class="use-card"><h3>भजे</h3><p>Use it in the batter for crisp, gluten-free fritters that fry up light.</p></div>
